description: Zenodo holds a University of Virginia SPW synthetic population for Spain, with a public ZIP and README under CC BY 4.0. The README identifies person, household, residence, activity-place and daily activity-assignment tables, plus a separate contact matrix and validation plots. It cites IPUMS for household inputs, GPW for population counts, and World Bank and OpenStreetMap-derived information for activity patterns and places. This package can supply a baseline agent set for national transport-access, service catchment or evacuation scenario simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the Spain release. A limitation is that generated daily destinations are not observed origin-destination data and cannot by themselves represent road capacity, train timetables or shelter use. The coarse version does not establish city-level fit for individual Spanish regions. The archive was not downloaded, so column values, location accuracy and the population total were not checked.
